ticker_news.title: Got $5,000? 2 Tech Stocks to Buy and Hold for the Long Term
ticker_news.description: Despite market volatility in 2025, Netflix and AMD present compelling investment opportunities. Netflix has shown remarkable growth and strategic adaptation, while AMD is emerging as a competitive player in the AI chip market, challenging Nvidia's dominance.
ticker_news.author: Anders Bylund

ticker_news.title: Prediction: 1 Stock That Will Be Worth More Than Palantir Technologies 2 Years From Now
ticker_news.description: The article compares Palantir Technologies and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD), suggesting that AMD could potentially overtake Palantir's market value in two years due to its diverse AI-related growth opportunities and more attractive valuation.
ticker_news.author: Harsh Chauhan
